description: This file implements the 'app_resource_usage' class and related functions for monitoring and reporting application resource usage metrics, including CPU and energy consumption, within a larger software system.

classes.name: app_resource_usage
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting and calculating resource usage metrics such as CPU and energy consumption.

methods.name: app_resource_usage::app_resource_usage
methods.description: Constructor initializing resource usage monitoring with a provided energy consumption reader.

methods.name: app_resource_usage::get_new_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves new resource usage metrics, including CPU and power consumption.

methods.name: app_resource_usage::update_cpu_usage_metric
methods.description: Updates CPU usage metrics based on current and last snapshots.

methods.name: app_resource_usage::update_power_consumption_metric
methods.description: Calculates and updates power consumption metrics based on energy snapshots.

methods.name: app_resource_usage::energy_usage_now
methods.description: Captures the current energy usage snapshot.
